test_title: PYST 68: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful passage:

1. Philosophical scepticism questions whether knowledge is possible.

2. This position originated in ancient Greek thought.

3. Later, it influenced Enlightenment thinkers.

4. Its legacy persists in modern epistemology.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The paragraph should follow a logical and chronological order, starting with a definition and tracing its history.
 
• **Sentence 1 is the first sentence** as it introduces and defines the main concept:
 
 
• "Philosophical scepticism questions whether knowledge is possible."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 follows naturally** by using the phrase "This position" to refer directly back to the concept introduced in sentence 1, establishing its historical origin:
 
 
• "This position originated in ancient Greek thought."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the third sentence** because it uses the transition word "Later" to move chronologically forward from ancient times:
 
 
• "Later, it influenced Enlightenment thinkers."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 concludes the passage** by bringing the chronological progression to the present day:
 
 
• "Its legacy persists in modern epistemology."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Philosophical scepticism questions whether knowledge is possible. This position originated in ancient Greek thought. Later, it influenced Enlightenment thinkers. Its legacy persists in modern epistemology."
